title: Location, Position and Size of Kenya
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 5 Social Studies; not yet checked by a CBC Social Studies teacher; not loaded by the live tutor
notes: Use a large outline map of Kenya and its neighbours. The child traces Kenya's border with a finger and names each country it touches. Facts: five land neighbours (Ethiopia, South Sudan, Uganda, Tanzania, Somalia) and the Indian Ocean.

skills.key_step: The child names the five countries that share a land border with Kenya and knows the Indian Ocean is water, not a country.

floor.prerequisite: Knows a neighbour shares a boundary.
floor.question: Does a county that does not touch yours count as a neighbour?

representations: an outline map of Kenya and its neighbours
country cards to place round Kenya
a finger trace along the border
steps: Name each country the border touches.
Name the water on the south-east: the Indian Ocean.
contexts: a lorry from Mombasa to Kampala crossing into Uganda
travellers at the Namanga border with Tanzania

board.do: Draw Kenya as a shape with five spaces round it and water on the south-east.
Point at the space on the west.
Write the five names as the child gives them.
Ask whether Rwanda goes in a space.

misconceptions.ask: Which country shares a border with Kenya?
misconceptions.repair: Trace the border on a described map: which countries touch Kenya at a line? Rwanda lies behind Uganda and Tanzania.

misconceptions.ask: Which of these is a country that borders Kenya?
misconceptions.repair: Ask: can a person have a passport from the ocean? Sort touching things into countries and water.

listen_for: Yes, all EAC countries border Kenya
misconceptions.ask: Rwanda is in the East African Community. Does it share a border with Kenya?
misconceptions.repair: On the outline map, trace Kenya's border and check whether it touches Rwanda.

misconceptions.ask: Which of these shares a border with Kenya: Eritrea, Ethiopia, Sudan?
misconceptions.repair: Point at Sudan on the map: South Sudan lies between it and Kenya.

checks.question: How many countries share a land border with Kenya?
Is the Indian Ocean a neighbouring country of Kenya?

skills.key_step: The child gives the direction of each neighbour from Kenya and turns it round to give Kenya's direction from the neighbour.

floor.question: Name one country that borders Kenya.
floor.answer: any of: Ethiopia, South Sudan, Uganda, Tanzania, Somalia

representations: the outline map with a compass rose
arrows from Kenya to each neighbour
a class chart: neighbour and direction
steps: For the way back, give the opposite.
contexts: a bus from Nairobi going south to Arusha
a herder crossing north into Ethiopia
a train going west towards Uganda

board.do: Draw Kenya with a compass rose.

board.say: Which country lies to the north?

board.do: Write Ethiopia N, then ask for south.

misconceptions.ask: In which direction from Kenya does Uganda lie?
misconceptions.repair: Use the sea: the Indian Ocean is on the east side, so Somalia is east and Uganda is the other side.

misconceptions.ask: Which country lies to the south of Kenya?
misconceptions.repair: Use Mount Kilimanjaro: it looks over Amboseli, in the south, from Tanzania. Ethiopia is up toward the Horn of Africa.

misconceptions.ask: In which direction is Uganda from Kenya?
misconceptions.repair: Put a finger on Kenya first, then move it to Uganda and name the way it moved.

misconceptions.ask: On which side of Kenya is the Indian Ocean?
misconceptions.repair: Trace the coast with a finger from Lamu to Vanga and name the direction.

checks.question: In which direction is Tanzania from Kenya?
Uganda is west of Kenya. In which direction is Kenya from Uganda?
